title: On the construction of large local arcs
summary: Motivated by the construction of optimal locally repairable codes, we introduce the new finite geometric concept of a \emph{local arc} which is defined as a collection $\mathcal{S}$ of disjoint point sets $S_{i}$ in $\mathrm{PG}(2,q)$ such that $S_{i} \cup S_{j}$ is an arc for any $S_{i}, S_{j} \in \mathcal{S}$. We focus on the upper and lower bounds on the sizes of maximum $k$-uniform local arcs.
